problem: Verified Value Created P0 tightened the shared company-ledger realizedValue aggregate to require execution and evidence, causing established company economics and projections to collapse to zero for valid historical verified value records.
root_cause: One field was serving two contracts: legacy ledger economics and the new evidence-backed PH-Pxxx Verified Value Created metric. The stricter eligibility rule was applied to both instead of only the new metric.
prevention: Keep economics.realizedValue backward compatible with historical verified value semantics.
Keep verifiedValueByProblem strict: executed=true, verified=true and at least one evidenceId.
Never strengthen a shared legacy aggregate when introducing a stricter derived metric; create a separate eligibility set.
Regression must prove both contracts in the same fixture.
